title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG templates, agent tool-calling quickstarts in Python and TypeScript, and accompanying docs site updates. Motivation: give developers ready-to-run examples for building retrieval-augmented generation flows and agent patterns that call external tools. This PR includes quickstarts that show recommended batching/embedding usage, simple evaluation prompts, and a docs site tutorial with navigation updates. Checklist: [x] quickstart examples (py/ts), [x] RAG templates, [x] docs tutorial and sidebar entry, [x] basic smoke tests, [x] CI checks passing. Notes: examples are intentionally small and environment-driven (uses REDWOOD_API_KEY and local vector store path). See linked Linear tickets ENG-1423 and PM-331 for context.
